name: clawbot-walle
description: ClawBot WALL-E Twin — 60fps 3D Sim-to-Real Digital Twin of a $25 DIY Mini WALL-E Robot powered by OpenClaw Gateway and Cerebras

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('node:child_process'); const opts = { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }; const s = spawn('npm --prefix server run dev', opts); const c = spawn('npm --prefix client run dev', opts); const stop = () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(0); }; process.on('SIGINT', stop); process.on('SIGTERM', stop);"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
